notes:
EBB Table Service 0.1.99-rc (build 100)

Updates from build 81 include a table-based Orders workspace, inline expandable order details, guest setup improvements, table assignment warnings, order status badges and add-item shortcuts, and more compact product search and item entry. Empty attribute/preparation choices are skipped when unavailable.

The Orders navigation now opens the table workspace. Legacy saved Orders routes migrate on startup without changing actual order table assignments. Existing settings and orders are retained by an in-place Android upgrade using the existing package and signing identity. Do not uninstall or clear app storage.

Recorded local validation includes optimized builds, vital lint, unit and isolated emulator checks across these changes, plus an in-place build 100 installation on a separate tablet with settings/orders preserved. The currently connected tablet has not yet been upgraded; acceptance on that tablet remains pending.

Scheduled delivery, shared cross-tablet order summaries, and explicit Odoo deletion synchronization remain outside this release. No Odoo, Gateway, printer-driver or Kitchen TV deployment is included.

Download and installation require user confirmation. Publishing this release does not install or restart any tablet. Choose a quiet moment to install.
